title: Deterministic nonbipartite Ramanujan graphs in every fixed degree
summary: For every fixed integer d ≥ 3, we give a deterministic algorithm that constructs a simple nonbipartite d -regular Ramanujan graph on every sufficiently large even number n of vertices. It outputs the full adjacency list in polynomially many bit operations, with an exponent that may depend on d . Every nonconstant adjacency eigenvalue lies strictly between $`-2\sqrt{d-1}`$ and $`2\sqrt{d-1}`$.
